levels.surface: أبو عامر عبد الملك بن عمرو

notes: ح joins two branches; the closing «عن أبي بكرة» is written once after the last ح, so it is the shared tail
«وسمى الرجل حميد بن عبد الرحمن» is between dashes (an editor's naming), left out; «رجل» stays unnamed
The second branch's «قرة» is a separate link from the first branch's «قرة بن خالد» (rule 9), and «بإسناد يحيى بن سعيد» is a back reference to the first isnad
